title: Strange Driving Laws Around the World
shared_passage: Watch a video about strange driving rules around the world, and for questions 1 to 6, choose the correct option.

questions.question: When is running out of fuel on a German motorway allowed?
options: Only when you can prevent traffic congestion or an accident.

questions.question: What must you do before taking your car in Denmark?
options: Check that the children are sitting safely.
Check that your children are using their seats.
Check that there are no kids near your car.

questions.question: What is true in Spain?
options: You can't wear sandals unless coming from the beach.
You must always wear safe footwear.
You can wear comfortable shoes or no shoes at all.

questions.question: What does the video imply about the law in Alaska?
options: You cannot carry a pet unless it's tied.
You can't let your dog climb onto the roof of your car.
You mustn't carry your pet on the roof of your car.

questions.question: When can you drive in Manila?
options: It depends on the number on your number plate.
If you can drive on Monday, you cannot drive on Tuesday.
It depends on the colour of your number plate.

questions.question: In Thailand, you mustn't drive without a shirt…
options: unless your air conditioning is not working.
